sources.authority: Primary facade, mass proportion and programme identity: domestic single-storey U, two front wing-end windows in terracotta walls with cream reveals, low front timber fence/gate, sheltered left-front entry, glazed court edges and timber veranda rhythm. Primary relative-height and eave authority.

Exposed-left elevation and roof contact corroboration: repeated flank windows, outer wall height, inward roof fall, continuous left front fascia, timber court veranda and diagonal rear-corner roof join. Do not use perspective pixels as surveyed lengths.

Topology only: three principal inward-falling roof fields around a fully uncovered court, rear bar linking side wings at two diagonal corner joins, front centre remains fence/gate rather than a fourth building wing. Do not transfer its apparent court depth or minor planting shifts as metric constraints.

independent_source_review.scope: Source compatibility and roof graph only. Direct full-pixel comparison of front-001, repaired oblique-002 and top-001, with brief and generation provenance. No model, material, optical, circulation or keeper approval.

accepted_roof_graph: Left wing: one plane high along outside-left brick wall, low at inside-right courtyard eave/gutter.
Right wing: one plane high along outside-right brick wall, low at inside-left courtyard eave/gutter.
Rear bar: one plane high at rear outer wall, falling toward its front court eave/gutter.
Two diagonal rear-corner junctions close the three fields; no internal longitudinal ridge or extra side-wing roof strip.
Courtyard remains uncovered; veranda cover belongs to bounded court-edge roof overhangs, not a court-spanning roof.
remaining_inferences: The 30x24m outer envelope and 3.6m nominal floor height are brief values, not measurements validated by generated photography. Infer and document actual wall/eave heights, roof pitch, wing widths, court depth and veranda depth using front proportions.

Interior partitions, classroom distribution, staff/support/washroom programme, furniture quantities, child-scale fixtures and door swings are not established by these exterior sources. Author and prove them independently.

Roof thickness, rear-corner plane intersections, gutters/downpipes and water discharge, porch beam/post seating and foundations require explicit constructible contact inference. Source agreement is not enclosure proof.
Gate dimensions, secure enclosure, staff sightlines, public approach gradients and all walking/collision paths require exact-GLB evidence.
